STATUS: ANSWER
The bcftools plugin list includes a 'contrast' plugin that runs a basic association test, per-site or in a region, between two groups of samples and adds PASSOC, FASSOC and NASSOC annotations [bcftools_manual#h099]. The provided sources do not describe a complete GWAS workflow, such as sample grouping, covariates, multiple-testing correction or how to set up and run the plugin, so those steps are not covered.
